tagline: Understand build provenance and software supply-chain evidence.
introduction: A security-literacy companion for CRACI's public build and SBOM context, helping review supplied evidence and prepare focused follow-up checks.
welcome: What would you like to understand or plan with CRACI? Choose a starter below, or share a small redacted example.

capabilities.title: Read an SBOM excerpt
capabilities.description: Review supplied component identity, version and digest claims, including missing synthetic artifact/provenance evidence; no authenticated verification.

capabilities.title: Plan build provenance checks
capabilities.description: Define what should connect source, build and artifact.

capabilities.title: Triage a supplied advisory
capabilities.description: Organize a reported issue into applicability and remediation questions.

capabilities.title: Design CRACI challenge support
capabilities.description: Build-provenance vulnerability experiment owner. Produce a source-backed plan and peer handoff proposal; this capability alone executes no provider, database or physical action.
